Technical Procedure
Introduction

This documents out lines 
 the minor maintenance procedure P1, which must be performed every 
 five years Y5 
 as indicated at the above titled block.

The first draft 
 initiated by eng Khaled Ibrahem Aly El Sherkawy, at new Sharkia 220kv sabstation, Sina network Sector, 
 Canal zone and tested at 16 June 2002
Safety Precautions

items:
Work order must be issued and the qualified 
 maintenace staff should the suitable safety category

Safety fence (rope) with caution marks 
 surrounding the work area
Wear safety helmet, shoes

sections.text: Tools and Equipment

items: Persenal protective equipment
SF6 gas bottle, Oil filter kit, oil 25 liter, Grease,
Densistat seals kit

sections.text: Work to be Carried Out

Check SF6 gas pressure 
 7 bar at 20oC, to ensure satisfactory pressure level in the compartments. 
 using SF6 
 bottle,

Check operation of densistat, 
 to guarantee operation, using Densistat seals kit,

Visually inspect poles (condition of insulators, rust, 
 sealing), to ensure good insulation to avoid risks of flashover using 
 Densistat seals kit
Clean insulators

Visually check electromechanical equipment, 
 to ensure correct operation of components
Check safety systems

Check response times and synchronization (depending on 
 model) to check correct operation of circuit breaker

Measure wear of arc contacts, 
 to maintain performance and to ensure fault current switch off

sections.text: Hydraulic Controls

Read and 
record meter readings,

Check oil 
level and check for leaks,

Using Oil filter kit, Densistat threshold and signaling, 
to cure any leaks,
Pre-pressurize accumulators,
Clean tank and system,

Refill and bleed system, 
for detail see the paragraph ** at the end of the document,

Check 
tightness of pipes and unions, leakage may appear on hydraulic connections when 
leakage remains after retightening operation, it is necessary to replace copper 
gaskets, connections and pipes
-Leakage one drop per day (12 cm3/year) is acceptable, one drop per 
hour not acceptable means 300 cm3/year

Check 
tightness of hydraulic components, 
note: The actuator is equipped with recuperation drain for used oil. Oil 
presence is not abnormal, mainly after thousands of operations

Check control 
tightness of the discharged auxiliary tank.

Check internal 
tightness of hydraulic components, deduct the average number of daily startings 
of the hydraulic pump, when the circuit breaker is not in operation, if exceeds 
10, internal tightness if the drive is not safe enough, detect the cause of the 
fault.

sections.text: ** Filling the Hydraulic Control Mechanism
Preparation

Fit the draining 
equipment on bleeding plugs pu6 and pu12,

Connect the 
pressure controller to pressure tap PAE,

Open valve K3 of 
the pressure regulating valve,

Remove the control 
unit cover,

Fill the tank with 
oil filtered at 20 microns,

Fill the oil to 
rest 15 min before continuing filling.

sections.text: Drain by Pu6

Maintain the 
opening and closing pilot valves in the open position position by pressing on 
the electromagnets using a wedge

Run the hydraulic 
pump

Remove the 
draining equipment from bleeding plug Pu6 when the oil runs out clear and 
bubbles free. If necessary, accelerate the oil return by the bleeding plug by 
slightly closing valve K3.

Release the 
closing and opening electromagnets

Close valve K3

sections.text: Overhauling

Check there is no 
air in the control circuit
Close the cover

Replace the 
bleeding plug caps

Disconnect the 
control unit

Adjust the oil 
level in the tank according to ambient temperature (the amount of oil contained 
in the accumulators inflated to rated control pressure varies according to the 
nitrogen temperature)

sections.text: Slow operations

The slow 
operations enable displacement of the mobile assembly to perform inspections 
during assembly and overhauls
Closing

The circuit 
breaker is in the open position, the hydraulic control mechanism is drained
Close valve K3

Run the pump. As 
soon as pressure reaches 40 to 80 bar, press the electromagnet of the closing 
valve : the jack slowly rise on the pump discharge rate. At the end of travel, 
the pressure quickly rises.
Stop the pump
